messages:
cara (AE): Heads-up: customer signed MSA. They want a short POC + committed reservation for ~100k qps-month (peak ~5k RPS). Need a concise reserved GPU recommendation, burst rules, preheat/runbook, and a quick fp16 vs 4-bit quant price ballpark. Also confirm KMS + 13mo logs.
noah (sales_eng): Got it. They care about p99 token latency ~200ms and ~40% chat traffic with ~2k token contexts.
danielle (solutions): Recommend 6 reserved GPUs (A100-equivalent) with burst credits to +50% (up to 9). AZ split 3/3. KV-cache warmup expected to reduce token compute ~25-35% for sessioned chat. Ballpark costs: fp16 ~ "$70k/mo" for 6 GPUs; 4-bit quant -> ~40-50% lower (~"$35k-$42k/mo").
sam (infra): Ops snippet and preheat (short): autoscale rules: scale_up if gpu_util>70% for 30s -> +1 gpu; scale_down if gpu_util<30% for 5m -> -1 gpu. Preheat recipe: T-120m start KV warmup; T-90m synthetic @50% 30m; T-60m synthetic @75% 45m; T-0 allow burst credits for 4h. Smoke cmd examples: ./kv-warmup --sessions 1000; ./loadgen --rps 3750 --ctx 2000 --dur 45m.
contracts-bot: Conditional SLO is acceptable: "P99 200ms while agreed preheat runbook (KV warmup + synthetic smoke) is executed; otherwise best-effort." Contracts will add ops appendix and model-license clause if customer supplies third-party quant models.
cara (AE): Perfect — need final numbers and a one-line autoscale snippet for the quote by EOD. Ping here when attached. :white_check_mark:
